policy: Apply by chapter, relationship and scene; do not import later events into early chapters.

profiles.guidance: Past-tense literary English; concrete sequence, lightly audible storyteller; no invented psychological explanations.

profiles.guidance: Responsive wit and exact verbal choices; spare turns and silence. Do not make every line melancholy or sarcastic.
Practical imperatives and sharp social perception; warmth with elders, clipped replies under strain; keep physical interruptions.
profiles.locator: 83 coaxing Grandmother then funeral accounting; 85 return-gift question.

profiles.guidance: Measured household authority, formulaic concern, interrupted gestures. Do not expose a hidden motive in narration.
Authority can soften into intimate teasing and incomplete speech. Preserve cryptic referents.
profiles.locator: 83 Little monkey; repeated heart’s own flesh / very life message.

profiles.guidance: Respectful service and quiet refusal can become explicit invective under coercion. Do not soften or make all speech abusive.
Distinct situations, not one servant voice: Aroma’s withheld departure speech, Musk’s practical care and teasing, Patience’s tact and support.
profiles.locator: 81 farewell / comb / needle; 82 and 85 bedside care.

profiles.guidance: Adamantina can speak in cultivated, indirect exchanges; Xi-chun’s brief refusals must remain brief. Do not retroject later withdrawal into early chapters.
Formal paternal correction and public duty; preserve unexpected hesitations rather than a permanent caricature.
profiles.locator: 82 study examination; 85 How old is Huan?

profiles.guidance: Yu-cun’s cosmological discourse is his argument, not certified narrator doctrine. Preserve Zi-xing’s practical interruptions and wine-table register; legal expediency must not erase the narrative’s exposure of it.

Arrival is socially tentative: Dai-yu observes and chooses how to answer; Xi-feng’s public laughter and attentiveness have an audience; Bao-yu’s impulsiveness changes the room. Do not import 81–85 grief into all early exchanges.
Maintain teasing authority, seductive instruction and Bao-yu’s literal curiosity. Prophecies are visible to readers without making Bao-yu understand them. Avoid a clinical explanatory voice.
